name: Combobox
summary: A text input with a list of suggestions that filters as you type.
description:
Use a combobox when there is a known list of likely answers but any text is allowed: towns, job titles, product names. When only listed values are valid and the list is short, use a select.

Without JS it is an <input list> with a <datalist>, which browsers already show as suggestions. data-v-combobox replaces those with a styled listbox below the input: it filters as you type (ignoring case and accents), marks the matching letters, and follows the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern for the keyboard. The typed text is always the value, so the form works the same either way.

classes.name: v-combobox
classes.description: The wrapper around the input and its datalist. The list opens below it.

classes.name: v-combobox-list
classes.description: The listbox, added by the JS. Also styles the "No matches" box.

classes.name: v-combobox-option
classes.description: One suggestion, role="option". The matching letters are in a <mark>.

classes.name: v-combobox-hint
classes.description: Extra text beside an option, from the datalist option's label (such as the county beside a town).

classes.name: v-combobox-empty
classes.description: The "No matches" message, a role="status" box shown when nothing matches. data-empty on the wrapper changes the words.

states.description: On the input, set by the JS: true while the list is open.
On the input: the highlighted option, while focus stays in the input.

hooks.name: data-v-combobox
hooks.description: Turns off the native datalist and draws its own listbox with filtering, highlighting and the combobox keyboard pattern.

events.name: v:select
events.description: Fires when an option is picked from the list, after the input's own input and change events.

keyboard.action: Opens the list on the first or last option, then moves the highlight and wraps. Alt+ArrowDown opens without moving.
Puts the highlighted option in the input and closes the list.
Closes the list; a second Escape clears the input.

a11y: Focus stays in the input while the highlight moves (aria-activedescendant), so typing and choosing never fight over focus.
"No matches" is a live status message, so screen reader users hear when the list empties.
Options are picked on pointer down, before the input loses focus, so the list never closes under the click.

examples.title: Town
examples.description: Type "ba" or "mayo", or press ArrowDown in the empty field.
